steps.title: Cru's replies can show pictures, files and data
steps.body: In Cru's conversation, a reply can now carry pictures, video and audio players, files to download, live frames such as a chart or a video link, and cards with tables, lists and progress. They stay in the conversation where Cru showed them, on the web, the PC app and the phone.

steps.title: See Cru think and speak in the conversation
steps.body: While Cru works on an answer, typing dots show where its reply will appear. Beside each reply, a speaking head plays it aloud when you tap it, and moves while that reply is being said. Tap it again to stop.

keys.text: hear a reply, or stop it

steps.title: Cru can fill the whole screen with its own UI
steps.body: When something needs the room, a dashboard, a board or a game, Cru can take over the whole of its screen while the bar to type or speak stays. A Normal view button on the top bar takes you back at any time, with what Cru showed kept as its panel.

keys.text: back to the usual Cru screen

steps.title: Peek at a parked chat
steps.body: A chat put away to resume later now has Peek beside Resume: read the whole conversation without starting it again. Parked view takes you back; replying or answering anything in it resumes the chat as usual.

steps.title: Choose how hard Cru thinks
steps.body: Settings, Voice assistant has a Thinking effort, from Low (quickest and cheapest) to Max (most thorough), for whichever model Cru uses. You can also just ask Cru to change it; it asks first.

keys.text: Low, Medium, High, Extra high or Max
